name: Far North
terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A South Australian zone. The Southern Flinders Ranges lie inside it. South Australia as a whole crushes about half of all Australian wine grapes.
